intro.text: An ardent and chemist who lives with his companion Geranid on a small island in the Reshi Sea.

items.text: Ashir joined the ardentia and was posted with Geranid to a small Reshi island, nominally to serve any Vorin people nearby but really to study in peace. They served the locals over many years while putting their research first, and fell in love along the way.

When Geranid found that a flamespren's size becomes fixed once it is measured, Ashir helped her work through it, realizing the size had to be truly measured and recorded, not guessed. He didn't know what it meant, but was sure it could change what people understood about fabrials and spren.

appearance.text: An older, portly man with a shaved head and a neatly squared grey beard, who speaks in a soft, kindly voice.

personality.text: Affable and calm, Ashir loves to talk. His Calling is cooking, but his real interest is chemistry, so he cooks odd experimental dishes and records the results, caring more about what is interesting than what tastes good.

He wonders whether to change Callings, since he can't see how cooking will serve the Heralds. He has a sweet tooth, favours theory over mathematics, and likes posing philosophical questions. He and Geranid love each other but remain companions, devoted to serving the Almighty.
